data.name: Nash
data.long_meaning: The name Nash is derived from the Old English word nas meaning 'edge, point, or tip'. It later evolved into the Middle English word nassen, meaning 'to flow'. This name was often given to children born near a stream or body of water. In its spiritual sense, Nash symbolizes the freedom and adaptability of the human spirit, which flows like the water it was named after.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual freedom and adaptability.
